name: BonqDAO TellorPriceFeed accepts the latest Tellor report unvalidated
summary: BonqDAO's TellorPriceFeed.price() returned Tellor's latest wALBT report via getCurrentValue(), with no dispute delay, staleness or deviation check, although anyone staking 10 TRB can report. The attacker reported a huge wALBT price and minted 100M BEUR against 0.1 wALBT, then reported a near-zero price and liquidated 33 other wALBT troves.
notes: TellorPriceFeed is immutable; the system started reading it when TokenToPriceFeed mapped wALBT to ConvertedPriceFeed 0x7d4c36c7, which wraps it, 14 s after its deployment. Three later wALBT settings kept that feed and changed only MCR and redemption fee, which sized but did not enable the borrow.

Valued at realisation (rule 12): attacker 0xcacf2d28 sold 558,408 BEUR for 534,535.91 USDC in five Polygon swaps (blocks 38793403-38793555) and, after bridging the wALBT (refs), 29.8M ALBT for 756.02 ETH and 20,511.91 USDT in 0x swaps on Ethereum (blocks 16536020-16544037). The unsold rest adds nothing.
TellorFlex worked as designed; the defect is BonqDAO's consumer feed. No other reporter submitted wALBT values before the anchor besides the protocol's two.
